has_subgraph.note: Ordinary (not induced) containment, host first: some injective map from the pattern to the host sends edges to edges (has_subgraphP), unconditionally. Every host contains the empty pattern, the empty host contains only empty patterns, patterns are never larger than hosts, containment is transitive, deleting edges gives a subgraph, and an ordinary subgraph need not be induced (has_subgraph_not_induced).
